# HetAas Atelier

> Handmade resin art from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India: bookmarks, earrings, keychains, coasters, pooja thalis, car hangings and custom name pieces. Every piece is made to order (curing 4-6 days). Payment details are shared by the artist after the order is confirmed on Instagram.

## Agent access

- Product catalogue (JSON): https://hetaas-atelier.aasthathakker.com/products.json
- Shop info and FAQs (JSON): https://hetaas-atelier.aasthathakker.com/content.json

## Policies

- Orders are placed as an order request on Instagram; the artist confirms and shares payment details.
- No returns, refunds or exchanges on customized items.
- Delivery is free on orders of ₹700 or more, otherwise paid by the buyer. Self pickup in Ahmedabad is free.

## Contact

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hetaas_atelier
